The '''Aguarl system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aguarl 3]].
